The pure docs tests parse their fixtures from markdown (askNodeOf) with a quoted selected and an answer text, so a round-trip regression on the quote escape would fail TestRowBackedBlocks…/TestAnApprovedVersionsBlocksAreHeldAsTheirRows; the other escapes are pinned only by pmdoc's own round-trip tests, which is where they belong. The 'treated as changed' consequence (his own re-answer carries over a non-row-true A) is pinned by TestCarryVerdict… and observed live (reword-reanswer). No defect found, so no red test written.
